decision: The owner explicitly approved routing the whole tcdnos.com suffix through the game-download group after reporting df-repo.yz.tcdnos.com, accepting that non-game software downloads can follow the same group.

runtime_observation.reported_activity: The user identified another missed host while discussing Delta Force downloads.
runtime_observation.source: User report in this chat; no packet capture, source address or signed download URL is retained.
runtime_observation.method: Repository first_match simulation in core and lite; not a live gateway observation.

dns_observation.limits: DNS is a time- and location-dependent snapshot of the delivery chain. No address or CDN canonical-name rule is added.

first_match_audit.method: Apply rule_covers to every canonical rule, replace the bytes suffix in a proposed source model, and compare core/lite coverage_metrics and selected first_match verdicts before editing.

boundary.selection: tcdnos.com and every subdomain, including bytes, yz, other providers and unobserved future names; non-game uses also follow the owner-selected group.
boundary.excluded_infrastructure: DNS canonical names and address ranges outside tcdnos.com are not admitted.
boundary.policy_override: DIRECT remains the existing default; choosing another member of the download group moves all matched traffic together.

verification_limits: The policy does not establish exclusive gaming use, Honor of Kings use, or a complete inventory of tcdnos.com services. Post-update client reachability and download performance have not been measured.
